raw_response:
I am old now, so I do not like to gamble with my land. On these 4.1 mu, I will still do wheat followed by maize, same as in past years. That is the safest way for me. Wheat gives steady grain, and maize after wheat makes use of the land without leaving it idle. I only have two people in the house, so I keep things simple and do mostly what has worked before. If I spend too little on fertilizer, I worry the crop will stay weak, but if I spend too much, that is also hard on my pocket, so I use a middle amount, about what I have seen work on my field and on my neighbors' fields. I have well water, so for wheat I will irrigate at the important times, but not too many times because pumping costs money. For maize, if summer rain is normal, I only give one water, maybe none if rain is enough. I will buy local wheat seed and a common hybrid maize seed like most people around here. I do not try fancy things at my age. I just want a stable harvest and enough cash left in hand.
